scripts.addon:build: web-ext build --overwrite-dest --ignore-files amo-metadata.json update.json package.json package-lock.json README.md index.html 'tsconfig*.json' tailwind.config.js postcss.config.js eslint.config.js vite.config.ts .amo-upload-uuid .ff-debug.json 'src/**' 'scripts/**' 'context/**' 'native/**' 'logs/**' '.bolt/**' '.claude/**' 'web-ext-artifacts/**'
scripts.addon:sign: web-ext sign --api-key=$FF_ADDON_USER --api-secret=$FF_ADDON_JWT_SECRET --channel=listed --amo-metadata=amo-metadata.json --ignore-files amo-metadata.json update.json package.json package-lock.json README.md index.html 'tsconfig*.json' tailwind.config.js postcss.config.js eslint.config.js vite.config.ts .amo-upload-uuid .ff-debug.json 'src/**' 'scripts/**' 'context/**' 'native/**' 'logs/**' '.bolt/**' '.claude/**' 'web-ext-artifacts/**'
scripts.addon:publish: npm run addon:build && npm run addon:sign
scripts.addon:update: npm run addon:build && npm run addon:sign
